保存したファイルは、Symbol Walletには直接読み込めません。バックアップや別の端末への持ち運び用で、KASANEの「Symbol Walletのプロファイルを読み込む」で読み込めます。

wallet.official_auto_title: Symbol Walletのプロファイルが見つかりました
wallet.official_auto_intro: このブラウザに、Symbol Walletのプロファイルがあります。KASANEに追加するには、Symbol Walletのパスワードを入力してください（秘密鍵はそのパスワードで暗号化されているため、パスワードがないと開けません）。

nemonster.title: NEMonster
nemonster.about: NEMonster は、NEMのブロックチェーンで遊べる小さな収集ゲームです。「モンスターを捕まえる」と、あなた専用の宛先へ 0 XEM を送るトランザクションが作られ、そのトランザクションのハッシュから、姿や名前の違うモンスターが1匹生まれます。公式の NEM Nano Wallet と同じ仕組みなので、同じアカウントなら同じコレクションが見えます。
nemonster.about_symbol: NEMonster は、もともとNEMのブロックチェーンで遊べる小さな収集ゲームで、KASANE ではSymbolでも遊べます。「モンスターを捕まえる」と、あなた専用の宛先へモザイクなし（0 XYM）の転送トランザクションが送られ、そのトランザクションのハッシュから、姿や名前の違うモンスターが1匹生まれます。Symbol には公式の NEMonster がないため、KASANE 独自の版です（NEMのコレクションとは別になります）。
nemonster.catch_title: モンスターを捕まえる
nemonster.catch_about: 送る金額は 0 XEM で、かかるのは手数料だけです。捕まえるたびに、新しいモンスターが1匹ずつ増えます（ブロックに取り込まれるまで約1分）。
nemonster.catch_about_symbol: 送る金額は 0 XYM（モザイクなしの転送）で、かかるのは手数料だけです。捕まえるたびに、新しいモンスターが1匹ずつ増えます（ブロックに取り込まれるまで、数十秒〜1分ほど）。

restriction.title: アカウント制限
restriction.intro: このアカウントが「やり取りできるアドレス」「受け取れるモザイク」「送れるトランザクションの種類」を制限します。設定はブロックチェーンに保存されます。許可リスト（リストにあるものだけ許可）か、ブロックリスト（リストにあるものを拒否）のどちらかで使います。

restriction.explain_address_incoming_allow: 許可リストにあるアドレスからの受信だけを受け付けます。それ以外のアドレスからの送金は失敗します。
restriction.explain_address_incoming_block: ブロックリストにあるアドレスからの受信を拒否します。

restriction.explain_mosaic_incoming_allow: 許可リストにあるモザイクだけを受け取れます。それ以外のモザイクの受け取りは失敗します。
restriction.explain_mosaic_incoming_block: ブロックリストにあるモザイクは受け取れません。
restriction.explain_operation_outgoing_allow: 許可リストにある種類のトランザクションだけを、このアカウントから送れます。
restriction.explain_operation_outgoing_block: ブロックリストにある種類のトランザクションは、このアカウントから送れません。

ledger.create_title: Ledger プロファイルの作成
create_message: Ledger の公開鍵だけを読み取って登録します。
秘密鍵・ニーモニックフレーズ・パスワードはこの端末に保存せず、署名のたびにデバイスで確認します。
ledger.app_hint: Ledger をロック解除して、{{chain}} アプリを開いておいてください。
ledger.transport_hint: Ledger を USB ケーブルでつなぐか、Bluetooth でペアリングします。ボタンを押すとデバイスを選ぶ画面が出るので、お使いの Ledger を選んでください。Ledger Live など、ほかのアプリで Ledger を使っている場合は閉じてください。
ledger.create_note: 最初のアカウントを表示し、続く4件は非表示で登録します（アカウント画面から表示できます）。
ledger.confirm_on_device: Ledger の画面で内容を確認して、承認してください。
ledger.no_encrypt: 暗号化メッセージは、Ledger では送れません（送り手の秘密鍵が必要なため）。
ledger.error_unsupported_browser: このブラウザでは Ledger に接続できません。PC の Chrome / Edge（USB・Bluetooth）か、Android の Chrome（USB・Bluetooth）をお使いください。iPhone の Safari は対応していません。
ledger.error_no_device: Ledger が選ばれませんでした。
ledger.error_disconnected: Ledger との接続が切れました。つなぎ直してもう一度お試しください。
ledger.error_locked: Ledger がロックされています。ロックを解除してもう一度お試しください。
ledger.error_app_not_open: {{chain}} アプリが開かれていません。Ledger で {{chain}} アプリを開いてもう一度お試しください。
ledger.error_rejected: Ledger で拒否されました。送信しませんでした。
ledger.error_unsupported_tx: Ledger の {{chain}} アプリが、この種類のトランザクションに対応していません。アプリを最新にするか、設定で「ブラインド署名」を許可できるか確認してください。
ledger.error_bad_response: Ledger からの応答が想定と違いました。アプリを最新にして、もう一度お試しください。（開発メモ: このアプリとの通信は実機での確認が必要です）
ledger.error_key_mismatch: つないだ Ledger の鍵が、このアカウントと一致しません。別の Ledger（または別のニーモニックフレーズ）がつながっていないか確認してください。
ledger.error_busy: Ledger が別の操作中です。少し待ってからもう一度お試しください。
ledger.error_in_use: Ledger を開けませんでした。Ledger Live など、ほかのアプリが Ledger を使っていないか確認して（使っていたら閉じて）、もう一度お試しください。ケーブルをつなぎ直すと直ることもあります。
ledger.error_unknown: Ledger との通信に失敗しました。つなぎ直してもう一度お試しください。

apostille.title: Apostille (notarization)
apostille.explorer_intro: Public apostilles sent to the notarization sink account, newest first. Signed (private) apostilles go to a dedicated account, so they do not appear here.
apostille.explorer_failed: Could not load the list. Check your connection and try again.
apostille.create_intro: Records a fingerprint (hash) of a file on the {{chain}} blockchain to prove "this file existed on this day". The file itself is never sent. The notarized files are saved as a ZIP together with a certificate and a history file.
apostille.type_public_hint: Records the hash only. Anyone holding the file can check it. Sent to the shared apostille account.
apostille.type_signed_hint: Records the hash signed with your key, so it also proves it was you who notarized it. Sent to a dedicated account derived from the file name, and can be updated later.
apostille.update_banner: Updating "{{name}}": the hash of the new file is sent to the same dedicated account.
apostille.fee_hint: A 0 XEM transfer carrying the hash as its message: only the fee is spent.
apostille.fee_hint_symbol: A transfer with no mosaic, carrying the hash as its message: only the fee (XYM) is spent.
apostille.zip_saved: The ZIP was saved. It holds the notarized files (their names include the transaction hash), the certificates and the history file.
apostille.zip_failed: The apostille was recorded, but the ZIP could not be saved. You can export the history file from the History tab.
apostille.keep_note: Keep the saved files exactly as they are, name and content. Changing even one byte makes the audit fail.
apostille.audit_intro: Select a file saved when it was notarized (its name contains "Apostille TX …") to check it against the blockchain record and see whether it was changed. The file never leaves this device.
apostille.wrong_format_hint: Select the file under the name it was saved with ("… -- Apostille TX … -- Date ….ext").
apostille.audit_error_hint: Could not reach the node. Check your connection and try again.
apostille.history_intro: Apostilles recorded on this device (per network). You can export them as a history file (.nty) for safekeeping, or import one from NanoWallet.
apostille.import_failed: This could not be read as a history file.
apostille.purge_text: Only this device's history is cleared. The records on the blockchain stay.
apostille.public_only_ledger: A Ledger account can create public apostilles only. A signed (private) one signs the file's hash with your key and derives a dedicated account from it, which a Ledger cannot do because the key never leaves the device.
apostille.public_only_multisig: Only a public apostille can be created in the name of a multisig account. A signed (private) one derives its dedicated account from the signer's own key, which a multisig account does not have.
apostille.multisig_not_eligible: This account cannot sign in the name of the selected multisig account (it is not a cosigner).
apostille.multisig_waiting_note: Other cosigners must sign too ({{count}} signatures including this account). The record is not on the blockchain until they have. The others sign from the multisig screen that lists transactions waiting for a signature.
apostille.multisig_waiting_result: Waiting for the other cosigners. The record goes on the blockchain once the signatures are complete.
apostille.multisig_lock_note: To wait for signatures, {{amount}} is put up as a hash lock (it comes back when the transaction is confirmed). It is not part of the fee above.
apostille.update_not_available: Only a signed apostille can be updated. It cannot be done from a Ledger or a multisig account.

settings.custom_theme_intro: Save up to {{max}} looks of your own (colours, corners, images) and switch between them any time.

settings.mijin_err_invalid_url: The node URL is not valid (use the form https://…).
settings.mijin_err_insecure_url: http:// nodes can only be on this computer or your local network. Use https://.

wallet.paper_wallet_hint_key: Puts the private key, address and QR codes on one A4 PDF in the KASANE design. Print it and keep it somewhere safe.

wallet.keystore_failed: Couldn't create the keystore. Please try again.

wallet.mnemonic_qr_password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

wallet.import_qr_password_hint: This QR code is encrypted with a password. Enter the password you set when the QR was made.
wallet.import_qr_wrong_password: Wrong password, or this QR code cannot be decrypted.

import_message_privatekey_only: You can also scan it as a QR code.

wallet.official_import_link: Import a profile from Symbol Wallet
wallet.official_import_title: Import a profile from Symbol Wallet
wallet.official_import_intro: Reads the profile data of Symbol Wallet (browser or desktop version) so you can use it in KASANE. The data is processed on this device only and is never uploaded.
wallet.official_import_not_found_here: No Symbol Wallet data was found in this browser. Apps on different addresses (domains) cannot share browser data. Copy the data with the steps below and paste it here.
wallet.official_import_howto_title: How to get Symbol Wallet's data
official_import_howto: 1. In the browser tab where Symbol Wallet is open, open the developer tools console (F12).
2. Paste the script below into the console and run it. The data is copied to the clipboard.
3. Come back to this dialog and paste it into the box above.
wallet.official_import_error_empty: Paste the data or choose a file.
wallet.official_import_error_not_json: This could not be read as JSON. Paste exactly what you copied.
wallet.official_import_error_bad_shape: This is not in Symbol Wallet's data format.
wallet.official_import_no_accounts: There were no accounts that could be imported.
wallet.official_import_summary: Importing {{derived}} account(s) made from the recovery phrase, {{imported}} private-key account(s) and {{ledger}} Ledger account(s).
wallet.official_import_summary_mnemonic: The recovery phrase is imported too (you can show it as a backup in KASANE).
wallet.official_import_mnemonic_dropped: The accounts of this profile are derived differently from KASANE (for example on testnet), so the recovery phrase is not brought over and the accounts are imported as private-key accounts.
wallet.official_import_mnemonic_unreadable: The recovery phrase could not be opened. The accounts are imported as private-key accounts.
wallet.official_import_network_note: This profile is for {{network}}. After importing, switch KASANE to that network.
wallet.official_import_skipped: These accounts could not be imported:
wallet.official_skip_reason_ledger_optin: Ledger opt-in accounts are not supported
wallet.official_skip_reason_key_unreadable: the private key could not be opened
wallet.official_skip_reason_key_mismatch: the private key and public key do not match
wallet.official_skip_reason_ledger_path: the Ledger path is not supported
wallet.official_import_same_password: KASANE will use the same password as Symbol Wallet.
wallet.official_import_new_password_hint: Symbol Wallet's password does not meet KASANE's rules ({{min}} or more characters, at most {{max}} bytes). Choose a new password for KASANE.
wallet.official_import_duplicate: Some of these accounts are already in KASANE ({{names}}), so nothing was imported to avoid duplicates.
wallet.official_export_hint: Exports this profile in a form that Symbol Wallet (the official Symbol wallet app) can use. You can log in to Symbol Wallet with the same password.
wallet.official_export_ask: Enter your KASANE password. The exported data is encrypted with this password.
wallet.official_export_with_seed: The recovery phrase is included, so you can add accounts in Symbol Wallet.
wallet.official_export_no_seed_testnet: This profile's testnet keys use a different derivation (coin type 4343) from Symbol Wallet, so the accounts were exported as private-key accounts.
wallet.official_export_no_seed_none: This profile has no recovery phrase, so the accounts are exported as private-key accounts.
wallet.official_export_skipped: {{count}} account(s) could not be exported (for example Ledger on testnet).
wallet.official_export_copy_script: Copy the console script for Symbol Wallet
official_export_howto: To add the profile to Symbol Wallet, paste the copied script into the console (F12) of the browser tab where Symbol Wallet is open and run it. The profile is added to Symbol Wallet's list (existing profiles are kept).
The saved file cannot be loaded directly into Symbol Wallet. It is for backup or moving to another device, and KASANE can read it with "Import a profile from Symbol Wallet".
wallet.official_export_warning: The exported data contains encrypted private keys. Anyone who knows the password can move your funds, so do not hand the file or the script to anyone.
wallet.official_export_locked: Too many wrong attempts. Please wait a while and try again.
wallet.official_export_no_accounts: There are no accounts to export.
wallet.official_auto_intro: This browser has a profile of Symbol Wallet. To add it to KASANE, enter Symbol Wallet password (the private keys are encrypted with that password, so they cannot be opened without it).
wallet.official_here_found: This browser has Symbol Wallet profiles that are not in KASANE yet. Pick one to import it without pasting any data.
wallet.official_export_unsupported_network: Export for Symbol Wallet is not available on mijin v2 (switch to mainnet / testnet).

namespace.renew_days_hint: Between {{min}} and {{max}} days, calculated at 2,880 blocks per day.
namespace.renew_invalid_days: Enter a whole number of days.
namespace.renew_over_max: The rental can be at most {{limit}} days counting what is left. You can add up to {{max}} more days.
namespace.renew_maxed: The remaining period is already close to the limit, so it cannot be extended now.
namespace.renew_expired_warning: It has expired. Past the grace period it may no longer be renewable, or someone else may have registered it.
renew_done_message: Your namespace renewal has been sent.

namespace.renew_alert_message: The namespace {{name}} expires in about {{days}} days.
error_duration_message: The rental period is outside the allowed range.

error_taken_message: This namespace is already registered by another account.

namespace.empty: You haven't registered any namespaces yet
namespace.no_parent: You have no parent to put a sub-namespace under. Register a root namespace first.

namespace.days_hint: Between {{min}} and {{max}} days, calculated at 2,880 blocks per day.

namespace.cost_hint: The rental fee is paid to the network at registration and is not refunded.
namespace.xym_short_warning: Your XYM balance may not cover the total cost.
namespace.caution_taken: A name someone else already uses can't be registered. Registering a root you own under the same name extends its period.

error_deadline_message: The transaction deadline could not be set correctly.

error_wrong_network_message: The selected network differs from the account's network.
error_unknown_message: An error occurred while registering the namespace.

namespace.alias_none_available: You have no namespace an alias can be set on (expired ones don't count).
namespace.alias_unlink_hint: Once unlinked, this namespace name can no longer be used to refer to the address / mosaic.
namespace.alias_address_hint: An address alias can only point at this account's own address.
namespace.alias_mosaic_hint: Mosaics you created that have not expired.
namespace.alias_no_mosaic: There is no mosaic to link. Only mosaics you created that have not expired qualify.
namespace.alias_confirm_ready_link: Link the alias with these settings?
namespace.alias_confirm_ready_unlink: Unlink the alias with these settings?

alias_error_deadline_message: The transaction deadline could not be set correctly.

alias_error_wrong_network_message: The selected network differs from the account's network.
alias_error_owner_message: The namespace and the address / mosaic have different owners.

namespace.alias_link_free_hint: Your namespaces that are not expired and not linked to anything yet.

harvest.balance_short: Harvesting needs at least {{amount}}. With less, the account cannot create blocks even if it is set up.
harvest.start_balance_short: To start harvesting you need at least {{min}} plus enough XYM to pay the start fee of {{fee}} ({{total}} or more in total). The balance is short, so harvesting cannot be started.
harvest.activation_note: It can take up to about 48 hours before harvesting actually starts. You can check whether the node accepted the request in the explorer.
harvest.partial_note: Only some of the links are set. Stop harvesting first, then start it again.
harvest.about: Delegated harvesting lets a node create blocks for you without moving your XYM. Starting links a throw-away remote account, a VRF account and the node to your account, and sends their keys to the node, encrypted. Those keys cannot send funds.
harvest.node_hint: Some nodes do not accept delegated harvesting. If the node does not, nothing is harvested even after setup.
harvest.no_nodes: The node list could not be loaded. Use "Enter public key" to give the node's public key.
harvest.cost_hint: Total fee of the link transaction and the request sent to the node (2 transactions).
harvest.load_failed: Could not load the harvesting status.
start_confirm_message: Harvesting will be delegated to the node you chose.
Enter your password on the next screen to send the links and the request.
The remote and VRF private keys are kept on this device, encrypted with your password (used to resend the request).
To change the node, stop harvesting first and start again.
stop_confirm_message: The links will be removed and harvesting will stop.
Enter your password on the next screen to send the unlink.
done_start_message: The harvesting setup has been sent.
The status updates once the network confirms it.
It can take up to about 48 hours before harvesting starts.
done_stop_message: The status updates once the network confirms it.
error_insufficient_balance_message: The fees exceed your XYM balance.
Add some XYM and try again.
error_already_linked_message: This account already has harvesting links.
Reload the status, stop harvesting, and try again.
error_deadline_message: The transaction deadline could not be set correctly.
Check your device's date and time and try again.
error_wrong_network_message: The selected network does not match the account's network.
harvest.error_unknown_title: Could not send the harvesting setup
harvest.check_balance_min_ok: Balance is at or above the minimum ({{balance}} / minimum {{min}})
harvest.check_balance_min_ng: Balance is below the minimum ({{balance}} / minimum {{min}})
harvest.check_balance_max_ng: Balance is over the limit ({{balance}} / limit {{max}}). An account over the limit cannot harvest.
harvest.check_importance_warn: Importance is 0. You can link the keys, but no blocks can be harvested until importance has been calculated.
harvest.check_reachable_warn: Could not read the node's information (it is unreachable, or cannot be checked from this screen)
harvest.check_reachable_unknown: This node cannot be checked (it does not publish its information, or only a key was given)
harvest.check_network_ng: The node is on a different network
harvest.check_peer_ok: It is a peer node (it can be used for harvesting)
harvest.check_peer_ng: It is not a peer node. An API-only node cannot harvest.
harvest.check_key_ok: The node public key to link matches the node's own public key
harvest.check_key_warn: The node public key to link differs from the key the node reports. Check that it is not another node's key.
harvest.check_synced_ok: The node is up to date with the latest blocks
harvest.check_synced_warn: The node is {{blocks}} blocks behind. A node that has not finished syncing may be slow to start harvesting.
harvest.check_health_warn: The node does not report healthy
harvest.check_delegation_unknown: Whether the node accepts delegated harvesting is a node setting that cannot be read from outside. After starting, it can take a while before the node accepts it.
harvest.stats_importance_none: This account has no importance yet. The network recalculates importance every set number of blocks.
harvest.stats_blocks_note: A block's fee is the total paid by all of its transactions. The harvest reward is the share this account received (a block with no reward record shows "–").
harvest.net_failed: Could not load the network information.
harvest.net_note: Values read from the connected node, refreshed every 30 seconds. Peer nodes is the number of nodes on the whole network (counted by the statistics service, the same value as the explorer's Total count), counting every type (Peer, API, Voting, and combinations such as Peer API, Voting API and API Voting Peer). On mijin v2 it is the number the connected node knows.
harvest.nem_net_note: Values read from the connected NEM node (NIS1), refreshed every 30 seconds. Nodes is the number of nodes this node can reach (NEM makes no Peer / API distinction). NEM fees are fixed, so there are no fee multipliers like on Symbol.
harvest.history_failed: Could not load the harvest history.
harvest.node_url_hint: The node's public key is fetched from it automatically.
harvest.node_url_err_unreachable: Could not reach the node. Check the URL and port (usually 3001 for https). It also fails when the node does not allow browser access, or when an https page connects to an http node.
harvest.node_url_err_wrong_network: This node is not on the network currently selected.
harvest.node_url_err_no_key: Could not get the node's public key.
harvest.keys_intro: You can link, unlink or replace the three keys one by one by giving their public keys: remote (signs the blocks), VRF (used in the draw for who creates a block) and node (the node that harvests for you). Harvesting is active while all three are linked.
harvest.keys_kind_remote_hint: Public key of the harvesting-only account that signs blocks (account key link)
harvest.keys_kind_vrf_hint: Public key of the VRF account used in the draw for who creates a block (VRF key link)
harvest.keys_kind_node_hint: Public key of the node that harvests for you (node key link)
harvest.keys_link_hint: Enter the public key to link (64 hex characters)
harvest.keys_replace_hint: Enter the new public key. The current link is removed and the new one linked in one transaction
harvest.keys_err_own_key: This account's own public key cannot be linked
harvest.keys_err_same_key: This is the key that is linked now
harvest.keys_err_duplicate_key: This public key is already linked as another kind of key
harvest.keys_fee_slow_warning: A transaction below the average fee may not be accepted and can end up expiring
harvest.keys_private_note: This screen only links and unlinks public keys; it never handles private keys. Harvesting does not start until the node has the private keys of the remote and VRF keys (set them up on your own node, or use "Start" on the Delegated harvesting tab, which creates them and sends them to the node).
keys_confirm_message: Enter your password on the next screen to send it.
Harvesting does not happen while the three keys are not all linked.
keys_done_message: It is shown in the status once the network confirms it.
harvest.keys_changed: The links on the chain had changed, so nothing was sent. The status was refreshed; please try again.
harvest.resend_about: If the node did not get the request (it was restarted or lost its data, for example), this sends the remote and VRF private keys again, encrypted for the linked node. No link is changed.
harvest.resend_key_hint: 64 hex characters. Only keys that match the links on the chain can be sent.
harvest.resend_err_invalid_remote: The remote private key must be 64 hex characters.
harvest.resend_err_invalid_vrf: The VRF private key must be 64 hex characters.
harvest.resend_err_same_key: The remote and VRF keys must be different.
harvest.resend_err_remote_mismatch: This private key does not belong to the linked remote key.
harvest.resend_err_vrf_mismatch: This private key does not belong to the linked VRF key.
harvest.resend_stored_hint: The keys saved when harvesting was started are available. Confirming your password is enough to resend.
harvest.resend_manual_title: You can also type other keys and resend with them.
harvest.reveal_note: These keys can only harvest; they cannot send funds. If you write them down, keep them where nobody else can see them.
harvest.reveal_failed: Could not open the saved keys.
harvest.resend_note: When harvesting is started, the remote and VRF private keys are kept on this device, encrypted with your password. With kept keys you can resend as they are. If none are kept (started earlier, for example), type the keys you wrote down. Without them, stop harvesting and start again (new keys are created).
resend_confirm_message: The remote and VRF private keys are sent, encrypted for the node's public key.
Enter your password on the next screen to send it.
resend_done_message: The delegation request has been sent.
The node receives it once the network confirms it.
It can take up to about 48 hours before harvesting starts.
error_resend_keys_message: The kept or typed private keys do not match the links on the chain.
Check that the links have not changed, then enter the keys again.
harvest.voting_hint: Link or unlink the BLS public key used for finalization voting, together with the range of epochs it is valid for.
harvest.voting_key_hint: Public key of the voting key to link (96 hex characters), shown when the node's voting key file was created
harvest.voting_start_hint: The finalized epoch now is {{current}}. Enter a later number
harvest.voting_start_hint_unknown: The first finalization epoch the link is valid for
harvest.voting_end_hint: The range from start to end must be {{min}} to {{max}} epochs long
harvest.voting_err_invalid_key: Enter 96 hex characters (a 64-character account public key is not a voting key)
harvest.voting_err_already_linked: This voting key and range are already linked
harvest.voting_err_invalid_epoch: Enter an epoch as a whole number of 1 or more
harvest.voting_err_range_reversed: The end epoch must not be before the start epoch
harvest.voting_err_lifetime_short: The range is too short. Make it at least {{min}} epochs
harvest.voting_err_lifetime_long: The range is too long. Make it at most {{max}} epochs
harvest.voting_err_overlap: The range overlaps a voting key that is already linked
harvest.voting_err_too_many: At most {{max}} voting keys can be linked. Unlink one you no longer need
harvest.voting_note: This screen only links and unlinks voting public keys; it never handles private keys (set them up on the node). An unlink uses the linked public key and range exactly as they are on the chain.
voting_confirm_message: Enter your password on the next screen to send it.
Finalization voting does not happen until the node has the voting key's private key.
voting_done_message: The voting key link (unlink) was sent.
It shows in the list once the network confirms it.

account.delete_failed: This account could not be deleted. The default account cannot be deleted. Make another account the default, then try again.

account.restriction_hint: Limit on the blockchain which addresses this account can exchange with, which mosaics it can receive and which transaction types it can send.

metadata.others_empty: No metadata has been set by others

metadata.others_caution: This metadata was attached by third parties and its content is not verified. Check who set it before trusting any link or instruction in it.

multisig.title: Multisig
multisig.intro: Create a jointly managed account that needs several approvals, or cosign for one.
multisig.is_multisig_note: This account is multisig and cannot send on its own. Switch to a cosigner's wallet to send or change settings.
multisig.min_removal_label: Signatures needed to remove a cosigner
multisig.cosigning_none: This wallet does not cosign for any multisig account
multisig.pending_none: No transactions are waiting for signatures
multisig.pending_hint: They stay here until enough cosigners have approved.
multisig.load_failed: Could not load the information (cannot reach the node)
multisig.cosign_done: Cosignature sent. Wait a moment, then reload.
convert_warning: Once multisig, this account can no longer send on its own.
If you lose the cosigners' keys you cannot move the funds. Back up every cosigner wallet.
Every new cosigner must sign later. Nothing changes until the signatures are in.
multisig.edit_note: A change takes effect only after enough cosigners have signed. Cosigners being added must sign too.
multisig.err_address_network: This address belongs to another network
multisig.err_address_self: The account itself cannot be its own cosigner
multisig.err_no_public_key: The account's public key is not known on the network
multisig.err_not_cosigner: This wallet is not a cosigner of the account
multisig.bonded_hint: Signatures are needed, so a hash lock ({{amount}}) is paid first and the transaction is sent to wait for them. If the signatures do not arrive within the lock period (about 41 hours) the locked amount is lost.
multisig.complete_hint: One approval is enough for this account, so it is sent without waiting for signatures.
multisig.xym_short_warning: Your XYM balance may not be enough.
confirm_dialog_message: Once your password is verified, the transaction is sent.
Review the details carefully before proceeding.
multisig.sending: Sending… waiting for the lock may take 1-2 minutes
done_bonded: It runs once the cosigners sign on the Multisig screen.
done_complete: Please wait for the network to confirm.
multisig.send_note: The funds come from the selected multisig account. This wallet pays the fees and the lock.
multisig.no_account: This wallet does not cosign for any multisig account
error_insufficient_balance_message: Not enough XYM to send.
Check your balance including the lock and fees.
error_deadline_message: Your device clock may be off.
Fix the time and try again.
error_wrong_network_message: The network setting and the destination do not match.
error_prohibited_message: This account is multisig and cannot act alone.
error_lock_timeout_message: The lock was not confirmed in time.
Check the history or the explorer a little later.
multisig.hint_min_approval: Minimum signatures needed to approve a transaction or add a cosigner
multisig.hint_min_removal: Minimum signatures needed to remove a cosigner
multisig.indirect_label: {{level}} levels up (you sign through the cosigner {{via}})
multisig.indirect_note: You sign for this account through another multisig account ({{via}}), so the signatures come from that account's cosigners.
multisig.multilevel_note: A cosigner of this account is itself a multisig account. It is approved by its own cosigners' signatures, so those are the signatures needed.
multisig.err_cosigner_loop: An account this account cosigns for cannot become its cosigner (it would loop)
multisig.err_too_deep: The multisig hierarchy is too deep (at most {{max}} levels)
multisig.multilevel_edit_note: A cosigner is a multisig account. A multisig account being added is approved by its own cosigners' signatures. Nothing changes until enough of them have signed.
multisig.added_is_multisig: A multisig account (approve {{approval}} / {{count}} cosigners). {{needed}} more of its cosigners must sign
multisig.tree_intro: Shows the multi-level multisig hierarchy like a tournament bracket. Starting from the signers on the left, each multisig account is approved once enough of its cosigners have signed, and the account on the far right is the one that is finally approved. Enter an address to look at another account (view only; nothing is signed or sent).
multisig.tree_input_hint: Leave empty for this wallet's account (a 39-character address starting with {{prefix}} can be entered)
multisig.tree_none: This account is neither a multisig account nor a cosigner
multisig.tree_alone: This wallet's signature alone approves it
multisig.tree_others: {{count}} more signature(s) needed besides this wallet
multisig.tree_legend: Each box is an account. A multisig account (blue frame) is approved once enough of the cosigners on its left have signed, and then moves on to the right. The accounts that actually sign are the ordinary ones on the far left. Use "−" / "+" to fold or unfold the cosigners on the left.
multisig.tree_flow: Read from left to right: signers → multisig accounts → the final account (scrolls sideways)

nem_setup.title: Set up NEM for this profile
nem_setup.message: NEM accounts will be created from this profile's recovery phrase. Enter the password once.
nem_setup.no_mnemonic: This profile was imported from private keys, so NEM accounts cannot be derived automatically. Add a NEM private key from Accounts in the menu.

aggregate.title: Aggregate
aggregate.intro: Bundle several transactions (transfers, mosaics, namespaces) into one and send them together. Either all of them succeed or none does. Including a transfer from another account makes it a bonded aggregate that collects cosignatures.
aggregate.empty: Nothing added yet. Fill in the form above and press Save.
aggregate.order_hint: They run from top to bottom. Removing a new mosaic or namespace also removes the items that use it.
aggregate.new_mosaic_hint: This mosaic is created in this aggregate. Its supply must be increased with a supply change first.
aggregate.no_asset: There is no mosaic you can send.
aggregate.mosaic_hint: Later items can use the new mosaic for supply changes and transfers.
aggregate.initial_supply_hint: If filled in, a supply change is added automatically.
aggregate.no_supply_target: There is no mosaic whose supply can be changed (only mosaics created with "supply mutable").
aggregate.supply_hint: Only works for mosaics whose whole supply is held by the owner.
aggregate.item_transfer_empty: Enter an amount or a message
aggregate.cost_hint: Rental fees are paid to the network and are not refunded. The amounts you send are not included.
aggregate.xym_short_warning: Your XYM balance may not cover the amounts sent plus the costs.
aggregate.caution_atomic: If any one of them fails, all of them are cancelled. Check the contents carefully.
confirm_dialog_message: Confirming your password sends the aggregate.
Transfers and rental fees cannot be undone. Check everything carefully.
done_message: The aggregate was sent.
It takes a minute or two to be confirmed by the network.
error_insufficient_balance_message: Transfers, fees and rental fees add up to more than your XYM balance.
Add XYM and try again.
error_deadline_message: There was a problem with the transaction's deadline.
Check your device clock and try again.
error_wrong_network_message: An address does not belong to the selected network.
error_conflict_message: A name is already taken or a setting is not allowed.
({{detail}})
aggregate.sender_public_key_hint: 64-character public key (the account must have made a transaction at least once)
aggregate.sender_invalid: This account cannot be used (wrong public key, or the network does not know it)
aggregate.sender_cosign_hint: This account has to cosign. Until the signatures are collected, the aggregate stays pending.
aggregate.lock_hint: The XYM locked is returned once the aggregate is confirmed (the lock's fee is not).
aggregate.bonded_notice: Some items need another account's signature. Sending pays a hash lock and leaves the aggregate pending until the signatures are collected, within its lifetime (about 40 hours).
aggregate.bonded_flow: How it goes: (1) the hash lock is sent, (2) it is confirmed (1-2 minutes), (3) the aggregate is announced as pending. Then the other {{count}} account(s) cosign.
aggregate.sending_bonded: Sending the hash lock and waiting for it to be confirmed... (takes a few minutes)
done_bonded_message: The aggregate was sent and is waiting for signatures.
It is confirmed once the other accounts cosign.
You can cosign from the Multisig screen.
aggregate.error_lock_timeout_title: 🟠 The hash lock is taking long to confirm
error_lock_timeout_message: The hash lock has not been confirmed yet.
Wait a while, then check the Multisig screen.
(Even after the lock is confirmed, the aggregate may not have been announced. If so, send it again.)
aggregate.full_notice: No more can be added (the limit is reached).

supernode.title: SuperNode Program
supernode.about: The NEM SuperNode Program pays XEM rewards to nodes that help keep the network running. To take part, the node owner's account sends an enrollment.
supernode.mainnet_only: The SuperNode Program runs on NEM mainnet. It cannot be checked or enrolled on testnet.

nemonster.title: NEMonster
nemonster.about: NEMonster is a small collecting game on the NEM blockchain. When you catch a monster, a transaction of 0 XEM to your own dedicated address is sent, and the hash of that transaction decides how the new monster looks and what it is called. It works exactly like the official NEM Nano Wallet, so the same account shows the same collection in both.
nemonster.about_symbol: NEMonster is a small collecting game that began on the NEM blockchain, and KASANE lets you play it on Symbol too. When you catch a monster, a transfer with no mosaic (0 XYM) is sent to your own dedicated address, and the hash of that transaction decides how the new monster looks and what it is called. Symbol has no official NEMonster, so this is KASANE's own version; it is separate from your NEM collection.
nemonster.catch_about: The amount sent is 0 XEM; only the fee is charged. Every catch adds one new monster (it appears once the transaction is in a block, about a minute).

txuri.unsupported: This URI cannot be loaded. Only transfer transaction URIs are supported.
txuri.multiple_mosaics: Transfers with several mosaics cannot be loaded (the send screen takes one mosaic).
txuri.encrypted_message: Transfers with an encrypted message cannot be loaded.

offline.amount_invalid: The amount, or its number of decimals, is not valid
offline.duplicate_mosaic: The same mosaic appears more than once. Combine them into one.
offline.message_hint: It cannot be encrypted (that needs the recipient's public key from the chain).
offline.message_too_long: The message is too long (up to {{max}} bytes)
offline.settings_note: The network cannot be asked, so the fee multiplier and the validity period are entered by hand.
offline.fee_multiplier_hint: Fee = transaction size x multiplier. Usually 100. Too low and a node may refuse it.
offline.validity_hint: After this time from signing the transaction can no longer be sent (6 hours at most).
offline.deadline: Deadline if signed now (current time + validity)
offline.clock_warning: The deadline is worked out from this device's clock. If the clock is wrong the transaction may not be accepted. Check the date and time before signing.
offline.done_note: Signed. It has not been sent yet. Carry the QR code or the JSON to a PC that is online.
offline.qr_hint: On a PC that is online, read or paste it in "Signing QR" to send it.
offline.sender_none: There is no account that can sign. A view-only profile cannot sign.
offline.recipient_hint: You can send to any address. Only its format is checked.
offline.mosaic_hint: Choose from the mosaics this account was last seen to hold.
offline.mosaic_none_cached: Mosaics other than the network currency can be chosen here once this account's balance has been shown while online.
offline.nem_note: Signs a NEM (NIS1) transfer. This screen does not contact a node either. The fee is worked out on this device by NEM's rules (there is no multiplier), and the deadline comes from this device's clock.
offline.nem_sender_none: There is no NEM account that can sign. A view-only profile or a Ledger account cannot sign here.
offline.nem_mosaic_none_cached: Mosaics other than XEM can be chosen here once this account's balance has been shown while online.
offline.nem_settings_note: The network cannot be asked, so the fee is worked out on this device. Choose how long the transaction stays valid.
offline.nem_validity_hint: After this time from signing the transaction can no longer be sent (24 hours at most).
offline.nem_clock_warning: The deadline is worked out from this device's clock. A NEM node refuses a transaction whose time is too far ahead of (or far from) its own. Check the date and time before signing.
offline.nem_hash_later: The NEM transaction hash is returned by the node when it is sent.

signqr.intro_lead: Read a QR code (or its text) that you received.
signqr.intro_safe: Nothing is signed or sent until you review it and press the button.
signqr.kind_signed_desc: Signed on another device. You review it, then send it.
signqr.kind_cosign_desc: A multisig cosignature that you are asked for, or one that is already done.
signqr.kind_template_desc: Loads the outline of a transfer.
signqr.kind_address_desc: Once read, it is filled into Send on the Home screen.
signqr.intro_adv_title: Data made with symbol-cli, an SDK or the REST API
signqr.intro_adv_body: The payload (hex) of a signed transaction, JSON that holds it and a cosignature body (parentHash / signature / signerPublicKey) can be pasted or loaded from a file as they are. A transaction that needs cosignatures (bonded) is treated as a cosign request.
signqr.invalid: This QR code cannot be read. Only KASANE signing QR codes (signed transaction / cosign request / cosignature / template) are supported. Read address and invoice QR codes on the send screen.
signqr.wrong_network: This QR code is for another network. You are on {{network}}.
signqr.use_signqr_screen: This is a signing QR code. Read it with "Import QR code" in Settings (or "Offline transactions" at the top right of the profile selection screen).
signqr.qr_too_long: The content is too long for a QR code. Copy the text and hand it over (it can be pasted into "Paste the QR text" on the reading side).
signqr.export_button: Sign and make a QR code (do not send)
signqr.export_hint: This is the signed transfer. It has not been sent. Whoever receives this QR code can read it in "Signing QR codes", review it and send it.
signqr.export_note: It expires at {{time}} and cannot be used after that. Anyone holding the QR code can send it, so be careful who you give it to.
signqr.cosign_qr_hint: A cosigner reads this QR code in "Signing QR codes", reviews the transaction and cosigns it. The QR holds the transaction hash (and the data itself when it fits).
signqr.template_hint: Turns the multisig account, recipient, mosaic, amount and message you entered into a QR code that another cosigner can start from. It holds no signature: whoever reads it reviews it and signs and sends it themselves.
signqr.template_account_missing: The account this template sends from is not a multisig account this wallet cosigns for.
signqr.template_read_note: Fills the multisig send screen with the sender, recipient, amount and message. Nothing is signed or sent until you review it there and enter your password.
signqr.template_open_button: Open in the multisig send screen
signqr.template_multiple: A template with several mosaics cannot be opened (a multisig transfer carries one mosaic).
signqr.expired: It has expired. It cannot be sent or cosigned.
signqr.problem_hash_mismatch: The hash in the QR code does not match the data. It may have been tampered with or misread.
signqr.problem_wrong_network: This transaction belongs to another network.
signqr.problem_not_signed: It carries no signature, so it is not a signed-transaction QR code.
signqr.problem_bonded_unsupported: A transaction that needs cosignatures (bonded) cannot be sent from here. Treat it as a cosign request.
signqr.problem_invalid_payload: The transaction data cannot be read.
signqr.problem_not_bonded: This is not a transaction that needs cosignatures (bonded).
signqr.problem_not_found: The node cannot find this transaction. It may already be confirmed, expired, or on another node.
signqr.signed_note: Review it before sending. Sending cannot be undone: it runs from the signer's account exactly as shown.
signqr.sent: Sent. Wait a little for it to be confirmed.
signqr.cosign_note: Review it and cosign if it is fine. Cosigning means you approve this transaction.
signqr.cosign_done: Cosigned. Hand over the cosignature QR or send it to the node.
signqr.send_cosignature: Send the cosignature to the node
signqr.cosignature_sent: The cosignature was sent to the node.
signqr.cosignature_qr_hint: The person who started the transaction reads this QR code in "Signing QR codes" and can send the cosignature to the node.
signqr.cosignature_note: This is a cosigner's signature. If it looks right, send it to the node to add it to the transaction.
signqr.target_unknown: The node you are connected to does not show the target transaction. If it is still waiting for signatures, sending this adds the cosignature.
signqr.image_not_found: No QR code could be read from this image. Choose an image that shows the whole QR code clearly.
signqr.download_failed: Could not save the QR image.
signqr.problem_contents_mismatch: The contents of the transaction do not match the hash that would be signed. It may have been tampered with, so it cannot be cosigned.
signqr.nem_message_encrypted: (encrypted message; only the recipient can read it)
signqr.nem_message_unreadable: (a message that is not readable as text)
signqr.problem_nem_unsupported_type: Only NEM transfers can be sent from here.

watch.new_desc: Enter an address to see its balance and history (no sending)
create_message: Enter an address to see its balance, mosaics and transaction history.
No private key or password is stored, so sending and other signed actions are not available.
watch.address_hint: A Symbol or NEM address (with or without hyphens)
watch.invalid: Not a valid Symbol or NEM address
watch.add_message: Enter an address to watch in this profile.
watch.add_wrong_chain: This is a {{other}} address. Enter a {{chain}} address, or switch to {{other}} in the menu first.
watch.add_exists: This address is already in the profile.
watch.empty_message: This view-only profile has no {{chain}} address yet.
delete_caution_message: This removes the view-only profile from this device.
Only the list of watched addresses is deleted; the accounts and assets on the blockchain are not affected.
delete_account_message: This removes the address from the view-only profile.
The account and assets on the blockchain are not affected.

offline_cosign.intro: Load a cosign request that carries the transaction itself ("Show cosign QR" on the starter's screen) by scanning, from an image, from a JSON file or by pasting. Send the cosignature QR or JSON in "Signing QR" on a PC that is online.
offline_cosign.not_request: This is not a cosign request. Load the QR or JSON of a cosign request.
offline_cosign.hash_only: This QR holds only the hash, not the transaction, so its contents cannot be checked and it is not cosigned offline. Ask the starter for a JSON file that includes the transaction.
offline_cosign.unknown_mosaic_note: Apart from the network currency, only mosaics this device remembers are shown with a name and decimals. Any other mosaic is shown by its id and the amount in the smallest unit (no decimal point).
offline_cosign.clock_warning: Whether it has expired is judged by this device's clock. If the clock is wrong this may be misjudged. Check the date and time before cosigning.
offline_cosign.cosigner_hint: Offline, it cannot be checked that this account really is a cosigner. If it is not, the cosignature is ignored.
offline_cosign.done_note: Cosigned. It has not been sent yet. Carry the QR code or the JSON to a PC that is online and send it in "Signing QR".
offline_cosign.qr_hint: On a PC that is online, read or paste it in "Signing QR" to send it.

offline_ui.lead: Sign on a PC that is not connected to the network and carry the result out as a QR code or JSON. This page never contacts a node.
offline_ui.import_qr: Scan a QR code with the camera
offline_ui.import_file: Load from a file (QR image / JSON)
offline_ui.import_payload_note: You can also enter the payload of a transaction made with symbol-cli or similar.
offline_ui.send_desc: Read the QR code or JSON in "Signing QR" on a PC that is online and send it.

guide.mismatch_message_known: This address / code belongs to {{chain}} {{other}}. The app is connected to {{chain}} {{current}}.
guide.mismatch_message_unknown: This address / code does not belong to {{chain}} {{current}}, which the app is connected to.
guide.mismatch_hint: You cannot send to another network. Check which network the recipient is on.
backup_message: You have not backed up your recovery phrase.
If you lose or break this device, the account cannot be restored without it.
We recommend backing it up now.
guide.custom_hint: Add links to any site or tool you like. They are saved only in this browser. You can choose where to add each one: both, Symbol only, or NEM only.
guide.custom_url_invalid: Enter a valid URL starting with http:// or https://
guide.custom_limit: You can add up to {{max}} links

addressbook.title: Address book
addressbook.list_white_hint: Someone you trust. Signature requests from this address do not get the unknown-sender warning.
addressbook.list_black_hint: Someone you are wary of. Their transactions are hidden from the history, and you get a warning before signing for or sending to them.
addressbook.error_invalid_email: The email address is not valid
addressbook.error_duplicate: This address is already in the address book
addressbook.empty:
No contacts yet.
Use “Add” to create one.
addressbook.whitelist_info: Contacts you trust. Signature requests from them do not get the unknown-sender warning.
addressbook.blacklist_info: Contacts you are wary of. You get a warning before signing for or sending to them, and their transactions can be hidden from the history.
addressbook.hide_blocked: Hide transactions from flagged addresses in the history
addressbook.other_chain_note: {{count}} contact(s) belong to another chain or network (they show up when you switch).
addressbook.storage_note: Contacts are stored only in this browser on this device and are never sent anywhere. Backup files are not encrypted, so handle emails and phone numbers with care.
addressbook.import_modes: “Add / update” keeps your current contacts and updates the ones with the same address. “Replace all” deletes your current contacts and keeps only the imported ones.
addressbook.import_invalid: This file could not be read as an address book backup
addressbook.import_empty: There were no contacts to import
addressbook.pick_blocked_message: “{{name}}” is a flagged contact. Use it as the recipient anyway?
addressbook.recipient_blacklisted: This recipient is a flagged contact ({{name}}). Check carefully that the address is right.
addressbook.save_prompt_message: The address you just sent to is not in your address book. Save it with a name to pick it next time.
addressbook.save_prompt_never: Don’t ask again for this address
addressbook.signer_unknown: The sender of this signature request is not in your address book. Do not sign requests from people you do not know.
addressbook.signer_blacklisted: The sender of this signature request is a flagged contact ({{name}}). Do not sign it.
addressbook.signer_whitelisted: A request from a trusted contact: {{name}}
addressbook.blocked_confirm_message: This signature request comes from a contact you flagged. Do not sign it unless you know exactly what it is. Continue to sign anyway?
addressbook.history_hidden: {{count}} transaction(s) from flagged addresses are hidden
addressbook.history_showing_blocked: Also showing transactions from flagged addresses
addressbook.signer_unknown_denied: The sender of this signature request is not in your address book, and signature requests from unknown addresses are not allowed in Settings, so it cannot be signed. If you know the sender, add them to the address book (as a contact or on the whitelist).

restriction.title: Account restrictions
restriction.intro: Limit which addresses this account can deal with, which mosaics it can receive and which kinds of transaction it can send. The settings are stored on the blockchain. Use either an allow list (only what is listed is permitted) or a block list (what is listed is refused).
restriction.watch_only: This is a view-only profile, so you can only see the current settings. Open an account that has its private key to change them.
restriction.load_failed: Could not load the restrictions (cannot reach the node)
restriction.mode_locked_hint: This list already has values, so its mode cannot be changed. To change the mode, remove everything from the list first.
restriction.explain_address_incoming_allow: Only incoming transfers from the listed addresses are accepted. Transfers from any other address fail.
restriction.explain_address_incoming_block: Incoming transfers from the listed addresses are refused.
restriction.explain_address_outgoing_allow: You can only send to the listed addresses. Transfers to any other address fail.
restriction.explain_address_outgoing_block: You cannot send to the listed addresses.
restriction.explain_mosaic_incoming_allow: Only the listed mosaics can be received. Receiving any other mosaic fails.
restriction.explain_mosaic_incoming_block: The listed mosaics cannot be received.
restriction.explain_operation_outgoing_allow: Only the listed kinds of transaction can be sent from this account.
restriction.explain_operation_outgoing_block: The listed kinds of transaction cannot be sent from this account.
restriction.address_hint: A Symbol address starting with N… / T… (hyphens are fine), or a namespace name such as nem.group. A namespace is replaced by the address it is linked to right now.
restriction.pick_held_mosaic: Pick from the mosaics you hold
restriction.input_error_own_address: You cannot use your own address
restriction.input_error_wrong_network: This address is not on the selected network
restriction.input_error_invalid_mosaic_id: Enter the mosaic ID as 16 hex digits
restriction.problem_too_many_values: This is more than one list can hold (512).
restriction.problem_too_many_changes: You can add or remove at most 255 values at a time.
restriction.problem_operation_lockout: An allow list of operations must include "Account operation restriction". Without it you could never change the restrictions again.
restriction.caution_allow_address: With an allow list, you cannot deal with any address that is not on it. Check that everyone you need is listed.
restriction.caution_allow_mosaic: Mosaics that are not on the allow list (XYM included) can no longer be received. Check that every mosaic you want to receive is listed.
restriction.caution_allow_operation: Kinds of transaction that are not on the allow list can no longer be sent from this account.
restriction.fee_hint: Setting a restriction costs only the transaction fee.
restriction.xym_short_warning: Your XYM balance may not cover the fee.
confirm_dialog_message: Confirming your password sends the account restriction.
A wrong allow list can stop you from sending or receiving. Please review the details carefully.
done_message: The account restriction has been sent.
It takes effect once the network confirms it.
error_insufficient_balance_message: The fee is more than your XYM balance.
Add some XYM and try again.
error_deadline_message: The transaction deadline could not be set correctly.
Check your device date and time, then try again.
error_wrong_network_message: The selected network differs from the account's network.
error_redundant_message: You tried to add a value that is already on the list, or to remove one that is not.
Reopen the screen and check the current setting.
error_own_address_message: Your own address cannot be put on a restriction list.
error_too_many_message: The list, or this single change, would exceed the allowed number of values.
Reduce the number and try again.
error_conflict_message: It does not fit the list's current mode (allow / block), or it is a combination that cannot be set.
To change the mode, remove everything from the list first.
Details: {{detail}}
error_unknown_message: An error occurred while setting the restriction.
restriction.multisig_note: You change a multisig account's restrictions as a cosigner. This wallet signs and sends the aggregate and pays the fee (and the lock amount when signatures are still needed) from its own XYM. When two or more approvals are required, nothing takes effect until the other cosigners have signed.
confirm_dialog_message_multisig_complete: When you confirm your password, the multisig account's restriction is sent.
A wrong allow list can stop this multisig account from sending funds or from being reconfigured. Check the details carefully.
confirm_dialog_message_multisig_bonded: When you confirm your password, the hash lock ({{amount}}) is paid first and the restriction change is sent to wait for signatures.
It takes effect once the other cosigners sign. If the signatures are not complete within the lock period (about 41 hours), the locked amount is not returned.
A wrong allow list can stop this multisig account from sending funds or from being reconfigured. Check the details carefully.
done_multisig_complete: The multisig account's restriction has been sent.
It takes effect once the network confirms it.
done_multisig_bonded: It takes effect once the other cosigners sign on the multisig screen.
error_prohibited_message: This account is a multisig account and cannot act alone.
Choose the multisig account from a cosigner wallet and operate from there.
error_lock_timeout_message: The hash lock was not confirmed in time.
Please check the transaction history or the explorer after a while.
error_blocked_by_restriction_message: An account restriction on this wallet or on the multisig account does not allow this transaction.
Check that the operation allow list includes aggregates and account restriction changes.
restriction.input_error_alias_no_address: That namespace is not linked to an address
restriction.input_error_alias_wrong_network: That namespace's address does not belong to the selected network
restriction.input_error_alias_lookup_failed: Could not look up the namespace. Check your connection and try again
restriction.caution_multisig_modification: "Change multisig settings" is not on the allow list. If you send this, the cosigners and the required approvals of this multisig account can never be changed again.

signrisk.dialog_message: Please note the following. Do not sign unless you know what this is. Sign anyway?
signrisk.transfer_to_blocked: The recipient {{address}} is on your blocked list.
signrisk.transfer_to_unknown: The recipient {{address}} is not in your address book. Check carefully that it is the right one.
signrisk.transfer_alias_recipient: The recipient is written as a name (namespace {{alias}}), so the real destination cannot be checked here.
signrisk.transfer_encrypted: The transfer carries an encrypted message. Its content cannot be checked.
signrisk.multisig_change: This changes the cosigners or the approval count of the multisig account {{account}}, so who can move the account changes.
signrisk.multisig_threshold_down: It lowers the approval or removal count (fewer signatures will be enough to move the account).
signrisk.multisig_add_blocked: The address {{address}} being added as a cosigner is on your blocked list.
signrisk.multisig_add_unknown: The address {{address}} being added as a cosigner is not in your address book.
signrisk.restriction_change: This changes the restrictions (allow / block of receiving, sending or operations) of the account {{account}}.
signrisk.other_unreadable: It contains a transaction whose content cannot be read (type {{type}}). Do not sign what you cannot check.

ledger.new_desc: Use a Ledger hardware wallet. The private key never leaves the device
create_message: Only the public keys are read from your Ledger and saved.
No private key, recovery phrase or password is stored on this device; you confirm each signature on the Ledger.
ledger.app_hint: Unlock your Ledger and open the {{chain}} app.
ledger.transport_hint: Connect your Ledger with a USB cable or pair it over Bluetooth. After you press the button, pick your Ledger in the chooser. Close Ledger Live or any other app that is using the Ledger.
ledger.create_note: The first account is shown and the next four are saved hidden (you can show them on the Accounts screen).
ledger.confirm_on_device: Check the details on your Ledger and approve.
ledger.no_encrypt: Encrypted messages cannot be sent with a Ledger (they need the sender's private key).
ledger.error_unsupported_browser: This browser cannot connect to a Ledger. Use Chrome or Edge on a PC (USB / Bluetooth) or Chrome on Android (USB / Bluetooth). Safari on iPhone is not supported.
ledger.error_disconnected: The connection to the Ledger was lost. Reconnect and try again.
ledger.error_locked: The Ledger is locked. Unlock it and try again.
ledger.error_app_not_open: The {{chain}} app is not open. Open the {{chain}} app on your Ledger and try again.
ledger.error_rejected: Rejected on the Ledger. Nothing was sent.
ledger.error_unsupported_tx: The {{chain}} app on your Ledger does not support this kind of transaction. Update the app, or check whether blind signing can be allowed in its settings.
ledger.error_bad_response: The Ledger replied in an unexpected way. Update the app and try again. (Dev note: talking to the app has to be confirmed on a real device.)
ledger.error_key_mismatch: The connected Ledger's key does not match this account. Check that the right Ledger (or recovery phrase) is connected.
ledger.error_busy: The Ledger is busy with another action. Wait a moment and try again.
ledger.error_in_use: Could not open the Ledger. Check that no other app (such as Ledger Live) is using it and close it, then try again. Reconnecting the cable can also help.
ledger.error_unknown: Communication with the Ledger failed. Reconnect and try again.

optin.enter_password: Enter your NEM NIS1 password to sign the Opt-in
optin.done_help: Want to know more about opting in to Symbol?

optin.no_profile: The opt-in demo is not available for watch-only or Ledger profiles.

postoptin.info_2: If you had XEM on the Snapshot block, you can claim your XYM
postoptin.info_3: this module to migrate your balance to the Symbol network.

postoptin.status_text_6: You have claimed your XYM successfully. You should now have received a Symbol transaction with the amount.

postoptin.public_key_placeholder: Public key must be 64 hexadecimal characters long.
postoptin.nis1_key: The public key you entered is a NIS1 key! You need to enter a Symbol public key.
postoptin.review_title: Review my Symbol account opt-in information
postoptin.modal_text: Please verify that the Symbol destination address is your Symbol account address. You can find your Symbol account address in your Symbol Wallet home screen. If it doesn’t match, please start the process again and provide a valid Symbol public key of the account that you own.
postoptin.modal_checkbox: I confirm that the Symbol destination address matches my Symbol account address
postoptin.no_nem: This profile has no NEM account that can sign, so the demo cannot be tried.

signmsg.about: Signs a text with your account's key. With the signature and the public key, anyone can check that the owner of that public key signed that text. It is not a transaction: nothing is sent to the blockchain and there is no fee.
signmsg.warning: Do not sign strings you do not understand, or text someone else tells you to sign. What you sign is treated as yours.
signmsg.message_hint: Every space and line break is signed too. The same text is needed to verify it.
signmsg.message_too_long: The message is too long (up to {{max}} bytes)
signmsg.signed_note: Signed. Hand the message, the signature and the public key to the other person so they can verify it.
signmsg.share_hint: The message, signature and public key in one text. The other person can paste it into the paste box on the Verify tab.
signmsg.share_nano_hint: The format NanoWallet reads as is: paste it into its "Verify a signed message". The message is the signed bytes in hex.
signmsg.verify_intro: Paste the text of a signed message and press Verify to check that the message, public key and signature match.
signmsg.paste_label: Paste the text of a signed message
signmsg.paste_hint: Text made by KASANE, or a NanoWallet signed message ({"message", "signer", "signature"}). JSON with just {"message", "publicKey", "signature"} also works
signmsg.paste_invalid: It cannot be read. Check that the message, the public key (64 digits) and the signature (128 digits) are all there.
signmsg.public_key_invalid: A public key is 64 hexadecimal digits
signmsg.address_hint: If entered, it is also checked that the public key belongs to this address.
signmsg.valid_note: The owner of this public key (address: {{address}}) signed this message.
signmsg.valid_nano_encoding: Emoji and similar characters matched as signed with NanoWallet's text encoding.
signmsg.invalid_note: The message, the public key or the signature is different, or was changed. Even one space or line break makes it fail.
signmsg.mismatch_title: The signature is valid, but the address is different
signmsg.mismatch_note: The address of this public key is {{address}}. A different account from the one you entered signed it.
signmsg.signed_empty: Sign a message and the signed message will appear here.
signmsg.result_empty: The result will appear here after you verify.
signmsg.manual_toggle: Enter the message, public key and signature separately
signmsg.symbol_signer_none: There is no Symbol account that can sign (Ledger and view-only accounts cannot)
signmsg.paste_hint_symbol: The text made by KASANE. A JSON with just {"message", "publicKey", "signature"} also works
signmsg.paste_is_nem: This is a NEM signed message. NEM and Symbol use different signature schemes, so it cannot be verified here. Switch to NEM from the menu at the top left and verify it there.

nemdns.title: DNS
nemdns.about: Links a website address and contact details to a namespace. From a name like "kasane.nem" you can look up what its owner registered.
nemdns.search_about: Look up the website address and contact details the owner registered for a namespace name (e.g. kasane.nem).
nemdns.search_hint: ".nem" may be added or left out.
nemdns.err_invalid_name: The namespace name is not valid. Use lower-case letters, digits, "_" and "-" only: up to 16 characters for the root, and up to 3 levels in all.
nemdns.err_lookup_failed: The lookup failed. Check the network and try again.
nemdns.expired_note: This namespace has expired. Its owner may have changed, and what is shown may be out of date.
nemdns.no_record: No DNS information is registered for this namespace.
nemdns.record_found: Information registered by the owner was found.
nemdns.record_empty: Nothing is registered in any field.
nemdns.open_site_note: Opens: {{url}} (an address the owner registered; make sure you trust them before opening it)
nemdns.site_not_openable: The website address is not in a form that can be opened.
nemdns.configure_about: Register or update the website address and contact details of your own namespace. It is just a 0 XEM transfer carrying the details to the pointer account; only what the namespace owner sent is shown in searches.
nemdns.public_warning: What you register is recorded on the blockchain and anyone can read it. Do not put personal information (a home address, a phone number...). An update shows the new details, but the old ones stay on record.
nemdns.owner_account_hint: A multisig namespace is registered in the name of that account (cosignatures are needed).
nemdns.no_namespace: There is no namespace you can register. (Expired ones are left out.)
nemdns.pointer_hint: This is the namespace's "address". Anyone can work out its key, so do not send XEM or other assets to it.
nemdns.hint_organization: e.g. a company or group name
nemdns.too_long: Too long (up to {{max}} bytes). Please shorten it.
nemdns.fee_multisig_note: Breakdown: transfer fee {{transfer}} (paid by the multisig account) + signing fee {{wrapper}} (paid by this account)
nemdns.send_note: Sends 0 XEM carrying the details to the pointer account. It does not show up in searches until it is confirmed (about a minute).
nemdns.sent_note: Wait until the network confirms it (about a minute); then it shows up in searches.
nemdns.sent_multisig: Sent in the name of a multisig account. It is recorded once enough cosignatures are collected.
nemdns.err_insufficient: The XEM balance is not enough. Check that there is enough to pay the fee.

symbolvoting.list_hint: The polls listed in the public index. This index is a dedicated address that only KASANE's Symbol polls are written to.
symbolvoting.create_intro: A poll is written to the blockchain and listed in the index. It can't be changed after it is created. It is sent as one aggregate, so a half-written poll can never appear.
symbolvoting.xym_short_warning: Not enough XYM. You need XYM for the fee.
symbolvoting.cost_hint: A poll is written as one aggregate of 0-XYM transfers with messages; only its fee is charged.
error_insufficient_balance_message: The fee is more than your XYM balance.
Add some XYM and try again.

symboldns.about: Links a website address and contact details to a namespace. From a name like "kasane" you can look up what its owner registered.
symboldns.search_about: Look up the website address and contact details the owner registered for a namespace name (e.g. kasane).
symboldns.search_hint: Write a sub-namespace with dots, like "company.team".
symboldns.err_invalid_name: The namespace name is not valid. Use lower-case letters, digits, "_" and "-" only: up to 64 characters per name, and up to 3 levels in all.
symboldns.configure_about: Register or update the website address and contact details of your own namespace. It is just a transfer with no mosaic, carrying the details to the pointer account; only what the namespace owner sent is shown in searches.
symboldns.pointer_hint: This is the namespace's "address". Anyone can work out its key, so do not send XYM or other assets to it.
symboldns.send_note: Sends a transfer with no mosaic, carrying the details, to the pointer account (only the fee is spent). It does not show up in searches until it is confirmed (about a minute).
symboldns.err_insufficient: The XYM balance is not enough. Check that there is enough to pay the fee.
